title: Saeima won't bother with Russia, Belarus parliamentary cooperation groups
summary_full: On Tuesday, November 3, the 15th Saeima decided at an extraordinary session not to form parliamentary groups to promote cooperation with the parliaments of Russia and Belarus in this parliamentary term, confirming Latvia's unwavering support for Ukraine and solidarity with its people.
